item: The emergence detector reads its counts in short per-day statements
summary: On a field corpus the manufactured-emergence producer ran 1,239 s while the WAL grew to 2.81 GB: its article counts were one GROUP BY over five weeks of mentions, a reader open the whole time that no checkpoint can pass. _article_counts now goes through windowed_group_counts (one day of one key range per statement, stand-ins left out as before), the read trending already uses. Counting rows per day equals COUNT(DISTINCT article_id): keyword_mentions holds one row per (keyword, article) with the article's one observed_on. A test compares the answer with the old single GROUP BY on three random corpora and fails when the value counts mentions instead.
